open_points.subject: install_transport_guards
open_points.text: answer an OPTIONS request carrying an Origin listed in settings.allowed_origins with a 204 preflight echoing the requested method and headers plus Vary Origin, together with the allow-origin and allow-credentials headers every allowed-origin response carries, and reject an unlisted origin with 403;
open_points.other_text: A POST to /auth/viewer/logout whose Origin is accepted therefore still passes through the body-size check, and so does every other request that is not refused before it.
open_points.question: Must an allowed OPTIONS preflight end immediately with the 204 response, or must it continue to the body-size check because it was not refused?
